The Endangered Species Act (ESA) establishes a federal program dedicated to conserving species that are threatened or endangered, along with the ecosystems they depend on. A key legal implication of the ESA is the "Section 7 Consultation" requirement, which mandates that all federal agencies must ensure that any actions they authorize, fund, or carry out do not jeopardize the continued existence of any listed species or result in the destruction or adverse modification of designated critical habitat. This means federal agencies must consult with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service or the National Marine Fisheries Service before proceeding with projects that may impact listed species.

Regarding your question about the day that comes after Monday: Tuesday.
